RECOMMENDED USE:
1 SCOOP
(Approx 33g)
200-250ml
Cold Water
or Milk
Shake Well
Before Use
Mix 1 scoop with 200-250ml of cold water or milk
and consume 15-30 minutes before workout.
Start with 1/2 scoop to assess tolerance.

WARNING:
Do not use if you are pregnant, nursing; have any
condition or taking any medication. Consult your healthcare
professional before use. Discontinue use and consult a
doctor if adverse reactions occur. Do not exceed scoop in 24
hours.

STORAGE:
Store in a cool, dry place below 27° C (77° F)
Keep away from direct sunlight and
moisture.
Keep out of reach of
children.
